# Joyful Responsible Abundance

Educational reading site by Luke Nathan Hayes. Public source rights apply.

- [Our future is still a choice](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/index.html): An educational guide to choosing joyful responsible abundance, from everyday agency and shared computing to superintelligence and Australian sovereignty.
- [A first look at the whole system](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/start-here.html): Begin with the human question, learn the three principles, and connect everyday problems with the AI race.
- [Explore the whole system](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/explore.html): Every component of the whole-system proposal, with direct links to its explanation and public projects.
- [People and practice](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/people.html): How a personal Aura, practical learning and continuity of care can help people carry their experience through life.
- [Shared capacity and ownership](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/capacity.html): Healthy living, time, useful work and locally owned computing give more people the means to act.
- [Evidence and public decisions](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/civic.html): Follow a household bill, a legal question or a local problem through evidence, responsibility and a public response.
- [Cooperation across the world](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/world.html): Connect personal growth, AI alignment, peaceful cooperation and the proposed global festival in July 2035.
- [Superintelligence and Australian sovereignty](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/sovereignty.html): Understand the race over AI, industrial capability and authority, then explore Australia’s practical choices.
- [When intelligence becomes infrastructure](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/sovereignty-intelligence-infrastructure.html): AI matters beyond the screen when the software, electricity, machines and authority to act become part of the same system.
- [Who owns the machinery and the decisions](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/sovereignty-ownership-and-production.html): The race combines model developers, cloud companies, factories, investors and governments. Their figures measure different things, and their ownership structures differ.
- [How computing robots and space could accelerate one another](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/sovereignty-industrial-feedback.html): Orbital power, reusable transport, factories, robotics and materials discovery form a possible feedback loop. The paper turns that possibility into requirements people can examine.
- [Keeping authority when software can act](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/sovereignty-authority-and-agency.html): The ability to act through tools and machines raises practical questions about permission, updates, procurement, local control and the right to challenge a decision.
- [Planning for five very different horizons](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/sovereignty-five-horizons.html): The paper tests conditional paths to 2027, 2028, 2029, 2031 and 2036. Its figures make assumptions visible and identify the delivery evidence to watch.
- [Making sovereignty something people can use](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/sovereignty-sovereignty-missing-middle.html): Shared local equipment, personal Auras, carefully governed connections and civic practice address different parts of the same question about who gets to act.
- [The complete sovereignty paper](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/sovereignty-paper.html): The full reviewed paper with dated references and the method behind its conditional scenarios.
- [Explore the scale and connections](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/tools.html): A transparent compute-cost calculator and an interactive tree explaining how the system’s components connect.
- [References and source documents](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/library.html): A searchable source library linking both papers, their references and the associated public projects.
- [Related public projects and repositories](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/projects.html): Explore the public sites and source repositories connected with the whole-system plan.
- [Words explained](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/glossary.html): Plain-language explanations of the terms used throughout the plan and sovereignty paper.
- [About the work and image credits](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/about.html): Authorship, edition details, image provenance, accessibility and reuse permissions.
- [Site map](https://auraofintelligence.github.io/joyful-responsible-abundance/site-map.html): A complete directory of the website’s guides, interactive tools, original papers, references and projects.

Original documents: documents/whole-system-preview.docx and documents/superintelligence-and-australian-sovereignty.docx. The source paper is dated 5 November 2026; future figures are conditional scenarios. See LICENCE.md for reuse rights.
